problem: Prove that BeBee can add a sixth authored Moon Garden region with a distinct night-garden identity while reusing movement-through pollination, Honey, Flight/Buzz 3, restoration, save v4 and region analytics, without adding a new verb, currency, mandatory spend, lethal hazard or per-region lifecycle.

decision.rationale: The exact-head deterministic and Chromium journey validates Moon Garden as region_06 in the same continuous authored world. Four new Meadows complete through the existing movement-through pollination verb, reuse Honey and Buzz 3, persist through save v4, and retain the six-slot nearby-patch visual pool. Night Lily, Starflower, moonlit palette and orbital/crystal landmarks provide authored identity without adding a hazard or management layer. The independent evaluation accepts the functional slice while carrying the existing geometric-art deviation to P8 visual certification.

governance.trust_boundary_change: No governance-critical file, workflow, validator, ruleset, permission or trust-boundary behavior is changed by this player-facing slice.
governance.bypass_analysis: No governance bypass is introduced or used. Exact-head CI, trusted evidence policy, deterministic tests and retained artifacts remain authoritative.
governance.rollback: Revert the Moon Garden feature commit to remove region_06 content and bounds while leaving save v4 and existing adapters authoritative.

alternatives.summary: Add four authored Meadows and reuse the proven data, progression, save, analytics and pooled-rendering contracts.
Generate a broad night biome; rejected because it weakens authored pacing, deterministic evidence and landmark readability.
Load Moon Garden as a second game world; rejected because measured P7 evidence does not require a new lifecycle.

acceptance_criteria.statement: region_06 contains Lumen Orchard, Starfall Glade, Comet Clearing and Moon Crown with Night Lily/Starflower authored identities.
The journey uses movement-through pollination, Honey, Flight/Buzz 3, no new spend, no lethal hazard and no new core verb.
Persisted Alpine completion derives Moon Garden at 0/4, reaches 4/4, records region_06 analytics and completes the six-region campaign.
Save v4 reload, desktop/mobile canvas coverage and zero console/page/external errors are retained from exact-head Chromium evidence.
GUI max_nodes remains 512, PATCH_POOL_SIZE remains 6 and view_state stays under the Defold msg.post buffer.

automated: deterministic Lua tests for catalog/order/eligibility/campaign derivation, movement bounds and camera bounds
verification.save_data_impact: No save schema bump; save v4 remains authoritative. Moon completion is derived from existing campaign_completion patch IDs and survives real settings save/reload.
verification.expected_economy: 3636 → 4846 Honey from four first-time rewards 280 + 295 + 310 + 325; no mandatory spend or replay.

visual_evidence.motion: desktop keyboard journey and mobile canvas coverage; movement-through pollination completes all four Moon Garden patches

measurements.expected: max_nodes 512; pooled patch slots 6; no view_state buffer overflow

comparison.conclusion: PASS WITH DEVIATION: functional Moon Garden content and continuous-world architecture pass; the pre-existing geometric illustration/typography/full-scene polish deviation is explicitly carried to P8.

known_limitations: The existing geometric bee/flower illustration, animation, typography and full-scene polish remain below the long-term release-art target; this is a documented non-blocking P7 deviation and a P8 certification gate.
Moon Garden adds authored content only and intentionally does not introduce a new currency, verb, lethal hazard or region lifecycle.
